gear.short: Medium and large dogs dodge too

help.body: Drag anywhere: a short drag moves the pack a lane, and each lane-width more moves one more. A tap moves one lane toward that side. Keys: arrows, A/D or H/L. Some obstacles move: an arrow shows where.
help.title: Switch lanes

help.body: Tips are {tip} each, on top of each dog's pay, so grab what you can. A dog that reaches a treat cheers its owner: +{treatHearts}♥. Aim for a lost wallet or a friendly neighbor, too.
help.title: Tips and treats

help.body: Skunks, thieves, dogs and more open cards. Each option costs cash, hearts or a debuff, and one always costs no cash. A puddle makes the pack Muddy. Debuffs wear off after {debuffSeconds}s. Hold a card, an icon or a bar for details.
help.title: Some bumps bring cards

help.body: Owners have {smallHearts}♥ small, {mediumHearts}♥ medium, {largeHearts}♥ large, and large dogs slow your lane changes. A lone dog's owner gets +{loneBonus}♥, a pair's lead +{pairBonus}♥. A plain bump costs that dog's owner {bumpHearts}♥; small dogs dodge 1 in {dodgeIn}. At 0♥ the owner fires you.
help.title: Keep owners happy

help.body: Every dog loves squirrels. Touching one does nothing, but a bubble and a line to it mean a dog is straining. Steer away and the pull is off; wait and the pack lurches one lane toward it. A pull never drags you into a bump too close to dodge.
help.title: Watch for pulls

help.body: Walk {walkLength} neighborhoods of {world}, each busier than the last. Each dog's pay is banked as you finish one. At a fork, each path brings an upgrade. Bring every dog home for the Walk bonus.
help.title: Neighborhoods
